name: Boneless Stuffed Whole Turkey
subtitle: A rolled, herb-free roast with creamy pan drippings
description: A boneless whole turkey is seasoned, filled with prepared stuffing, roasted in two stages, and served with a quick cream pan sauce.

ingredients.preparation: neck and giblets removed, and bones removed (see video and footnotes)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Pat the boneless turkey dry and lay it flat, skin-side down.
Season the turkey with the salt and pepper. Spread the prepared stuffing over the meat, leaving a narrow border.
Fold the turkey around the stuffing into a compact roast, then secure it as needed so the filling stays enclosed.
Place the stuffed turkey in a roasting pan, season the outside with salt, and roast at 450°F for 15 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 325°F and continue roasting until the thickest portion of the turkey and the center of the stuffing reach 165°F on a food thermometer, about 90 minutes more.
Transfer the turkey to a cutting board and let it rest for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, place the pan drippings over heat, stir in the heavy cream, and cook until combined, about 7 minutes.
Slice the rested turkey and serve with the creamy pan drippings.
